event.ione_courtship.intro.text: I've read hundreds of love stories, and not one told me how to ask this. So, plainly: would you court me? I rewrote that fourteen times.
event.ione_courtship.intro.why: eleven is Hazel's number (eleven lines, eleven cents); give Ione her own

event.ione_courtship2.intro.text: You asked me to wait. The question sat by the desk bell all this while. It held up. Would you court me?
event.ione_courtship2.intro.why: remembers where she promised to keep it in the first ask

event.ione_partners.intro.text: Sit, please. I wrote you a letter. It runs four pages. I'll read it, and you'll pretend not to blush.
event.ione_partners.intro.why: heart 8 already opens on 'Come'; vary the opening word

event.ione_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.ione.letter}The letter's in my favorite book now, marking the best page. Both are yours, eventually.{else}{if choice:courtship.ione.read}Your voice, my library. I've marked the spot where you stood. Nobody else may stand there. Hazel may.{else}The shore was bright. I forgot the book entirely. ...I'd like to see it in winter. With you.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_partners.after.why: r1 already has books listening; the read branch now ends on a joke of its own

event.ione_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.ione.wish}Noon came and went, and I never opened the new book. I was too busy being wished well.{else}{if choice:bday.ione.read}Someone read to me on my birthday. I've put it in the ledger, under returned with interest.{else}The bookmark's holding a very good place. I'd been using a tea label.{/if}{/if}
event.ione_birthday.after.why: wish branch no longer repeats r0 and calls back the noon book; read branch drops the third 'books are listening' tic

dlg.ione.birthday.r1.text: The first page, aloud. Nobody's read to me since I was small. I'll close my eyes, if you don't mind.
dlg.ione.birthday.r1.why: 'Slowly, please' was already the shelf scene's line

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l2.text: Dr. Penn. Your clinic stayed lit two hours past. I could see your lamp from my desk.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l2.why: 'stayed open two' read as a typo; now the count answers hers plainly

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l2.text: It's the calm kind. Even the library stove stopped ticking once the pot was on it.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l2.why: Odalys answers 'If the stove approves'; my line now gives her the stove

threads.ione_heart2: Who drew the coast chart and meant to come back for the shells, and what is the cove where the ink gives out like in winter?
threads.ione_heart5: Three low tides circled in ink: which evening will the beach walk be?
threads.reading_night: Who is the fifth chair for, next time, with the door left open?
threads.festival_winter_lanterns: Why does Ione's lantern always drift toward the sea?
threads.ione_heart8: Who will the set-aside book reach, who reads the note, or what the shelf was listening for.
threads.ione_birthday: Which crooked favorite book, which ledger, which page: small things the player can ask about next visit.
threads.ione_courtship: The first page of a new book, read aloud, Sunday: what book has she chosen?
threads.ione_courtship2: If still not yet, the question goes back by the desk bell.
threads.ione_partners: The sea in winter, with her; or the best page her letter now marks.
threads.overheard_hazel_ione_1: Who sorted the mysteries by color?
threads.overheard_hazel_ione_2: What is the seven-years-overdue book Hazel keeps finishing?
threads.overheard_hazel_ione_3: The lump in the window chair's cushion, and whether Hazel takes the seat after lunch.
threads.overheard_odalys_ione_1: Will either of them actually go home on time tomorrow?
threads.overheard_odalys_ione_2: Which book has a two-page first chapter?
threads.overheard_odalys_ione_3: Does slow cold tea count as a remedy?

notes: No R1 note names Ione's lines beyond my own; both of mine (courtship2 intro, partners 'rest of the day') stand.
overheard_odalys_ione_3: Odalys's 'If the stove approves' had no setup after R1; I fixed my side by giving the library a stove. Odalys's writer may want to check it reads right.
Eleven was used by Hazel twice (poem lines, fines); Ione's courtship rewrite count is now fourteen.
